description: Self trust is a gift , use it. #trusttheprocess #confidence #PersonalGrowth #selflove
transcript: I trust myself, and I trust that I know what I'm doing. If I am making a choice, it is the very best choice for Tali in that moment. And the confidence in knowing that allows me to explore. It allows me to move when it is time to move. I do not stay anywhere longer than necessary because I trust myself enough to know that I am making the very best decision for my life.
